description:
Embark on a bay adventure with San Diego Boat Rentals, conveniently located at the Coronado Ferry Landing. Get ready to make waves as you experience the thrill of boating on San Diego Bay!

Max of 8 people per speed boat.
what_is_included:
The experience includes a high-thrill speed boat adventure for up to 10 guests departing from the Coronado Ferry Landing to explore San Diego Bay.

*Fuel included
*Life Jackets included for all passengers
*All taxes and fees included
